svg.title: Where does your customer's data go?
svg.desc: Left: with a hosted parsing API, the customer statement leaves your perimeter for a third-party service and its storage and subprocessors. Right: with Panini running in-process, the statement, the Panini library and the typed output all stay inside your perimeter. Core packages contain no networking code; the optional fiu-client connects only to the Account Aggregator you configure.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
